_meta.method: NHS ODS ORD API v2-0-0, one GET per code: https://directory.spineservices.nhs.uk/ORD/2-0-0/organisations/<CODE> (JSON, ~1 request per 1.2 s, fetched 2026-10-11T05:14:39Z..2026-10-11T05:17:55Z). Role, relationship and record-class code systems read from /ORD/2-0-0/roles, /rels and /recordclasses to name RO*/RE*/RC* ids. name/status = Organisation.Name/Status as published; linked.role = the primaryRole's display name (ICBs carry primary role STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP RO261 with active non-primary role INTEGRATED CARE BOARD RO318, listed in active_roles). level: 'site' = record class RC2 HSCSite and/or an active RE6 IS OPERATED BY relationship (parent = its target); 'other' = holds the SUB ICB LOCATION role RO319 (parent = its active RE5 IS LOCATED IN THE GEOGRAPHY OF target, the ICB); else 'organisation'. successor = Succs entries of Type Successor. Codes named by parents, successors, sub-division and geography relationships were fetched too so their names could be recorded. The ODS Status field stays Active for the ICBs abolished on 2026-04-01 (only their Legal end date and a Successor entry show it), so legal_end is recorded separately. The PPON-shaped PWNJ-1991-NGDW was tried as PWNJ1991NGDW and as published, plus one ORD Name search for its DB name (context only). The ORD API has no name history, so other_names is empty throughout.
